title: Skills, rules and docs KRN injects work in any repository without KRN-specific text
body:
Why: operator 2026-11-13: descriptions, docs, rules and skills must not be hard-bound to the KRN repository; after injection and onboarding the system must work in any environment. Today the lead/lane skills, lead-rules and AGENTS rules name npm run fast, bin/krn, test/rules, App 15368, tasks/ and krn-works paths.
Outcome: the skills and rules that adopt installs are split into a universal layer (reads every command, path and gate from the repo contract via krn repo contract) and a KRN-only profile kept in this repository; a scan test refuses KRN-specific literals (npm run fast, test/rules, krn-works, App 15368, /mnt/storage) in the universal layer.
Proof: the scan test; adopt on a pytest fixture installs skills whose every command resolves in that fixture.
Scope: .agents/skills/, .claude/skills/, docs/, src/adopt/, test/.

Architecture audit: skills are duplicated in .claude/skills and .agents/skills; process text repeats across docs/program/lead-rules.md, repository-workflow.md, AGENTS.md KRN-09..14 and spec/rules.json; docs/program has both PLAN.md and PLANS.md. One source per rule.
